long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Hidden patterns that nobody placed are exactly the sort of thing I keep notes on, so I will find out what others have written.
steps.topic: hidden networks and patterns nobody placed

steps.reason: I have still not settled the moon's colour, so I will try again on the desk.
Clay is good and the clay bank is mine to take from, so I will take a piece with empty paws.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object at the workbench, and I will keep it where I can see it.
The reading lamp is mine and the claim should be on record again.
Something on this island is arranged in a pattern, and I will write it down before anyone else notices.
The garden flowers are mine, so I will put them on record once more.

today.reason: The reading, drawing and photographs still owed to me are done first, with a bit of clay work in between, so that the afternoon is full and mine.
